selection_rationale: Indices 3, 7, and 4 correspond to surveys published in 2025 (Survey on Monocular Metric Depth Estimation), 2024 (Deep Learning-based Depth Estimation Methods from Monocular Image and Videos: A Comprehensive Survey), and 2021 (Towards Real-Time Monocular Depth Estimation for Robotics: A Survey). These papers focus explicitly on monocular depth estimation, cover recent methodological advances, and include benchmark discussions, making them directly relevant for a 2023‑2025 literature synthesis. The remaining papers are either older (pre‑2020) surveys, focus on binocular stereo, or target niche domains (e.g., endoscopy) that do not align with the core topic.
